2608.24747.title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
2608.24747.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are trained with reinforcement learning (RL) for complex decision-making tasks. However, most RL-trained agents remain episodic and cannot accumulate reusable knowledge across episodes. Recent skill-based approaches, such as SkillRL, attempt to address this issue by extracting skills from raw trajectories, but treat the skill bank as an append-only repository without verifying whether stored skills remain effective. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a framework for continuous skill evolution that enables skills to be verified and refined through environment interaction. By making skill usage explicit during agent interaction, RL can directly optimize both environment actions and skill invocation decisions. SkillForge further introduces evidence-based skill verification and multi-pathway skill induction, allowing the skill bank to continuously grow while maintaining its quality. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld show that SkillForge consistently outperforms SkillRL, demonstrating the effectiveness of continuously verified skills in training stronger LLM agents.
2608.24747.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理人使用強化學習（RL）進行複雜決策任務的訓練。<lb/>然而，大多數經過RL訓練的代理人仍然是情節性的，無法在情節之間累積可重用的知識。<lb/>最近的基於技能的方法，如SkillRL，試圖通過從原始軌跡中提取技能來解決這個問題，但將技能庫視為僅可附加的存儲庫，而不驗證存儲的技能是否仍然有效。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了SkillForge，一個持續技能演進的框架，能夠通過環境互動來驗證和完善技能。<lb/>通過在代理人互動過程中明確技能使用，RL可以直接優化環境行動和技能調用決策。<lb/>SkillForge進一步引入基於證據的技能驗證和多路徑技能引導，允許技能庫在保持其質量的同時持續增長。<lb/>在ALFWorld、WebShop和AppWorld上的大量實驗顯示，SkillForge始終優於SkillRL，證明了持續驗證的技能在訓練更強大的LLM代理人中的有效性。
